title: What It Takes: Johnny Cash (1/4)
summaryZh: 節目開場精選名人語錄，並介紹本集主角鄉村歌手強尼‧凱許。
source: VOA Learning English (public domain) — What It Takes

sentences.text: Adame, this child is gifted, and I heard that enough that I started to believe it.
sentences.zh: Adame，這孩子有天分。這句話我聽多了，久了自己也開始相信。

sentences.text: If you have the opportunity, not a perfect opportunity, and you don't take it, you may never have another chance.
sentences.zh: 如果機會來了，就算不是完美的機會，你卻沒有把握住，可能就再也沒有下一次了。

sentences.text: It was just like the picture started to form itself.
sentences.zh: 就好像那個畫面自己慢慢成形了一樣。

sentences.text: There was no way in which a lie could prevail over the truth, darkness over light, death over life.
sentences.zh: 謊言不可能勝過真理，黑暗不可能勝過光明，死亡也不可能勝過生命。

sentences.text: Every day I wake up and decide, today I'm going to love my life.
sentences.zh: 我每天醒來就決定，今天我要好好愛我的人生。

sentences.text: My advice is, if they're going to break your leg once when you go in that place, stay out of there.
sentences.zh: 我的建議是，如果你一走進那個地方就會被打斷腿，那就別去。

sentences.text: And then along come these differential experiences that you don't look for, you don't plan for, but boy, you better not miss them.
sentences.zh: 然後就會出現一些與眾不同的經歷，你沒去找、也沒計畫過，但天啊，你最好別錯過。

sentences.text: This is What It Takes, a podcast about passion, vision, and perseverance.
sentences.zh: 這裡是《What It Takes》，一個談熱情、遠見和毅力的 podcast。

sentences.text: Every episode of What It Takes features a revealing conversation with someone who has literally changed the world.
sentences.zh: 《What It Takes》每一集都會和一位真正改變了世界的人深入對談。

sentences.text: Whether it's Rosa Parks, Steve Jobs, Jonas Salk, Jane Goodall, or today's guest, Johnny Cash.
sentences.zh: 不管是羅莎‧帕克斯、賈伯斯、喬納斯‧沙克、珍‧古德，還是今天的來賓強尼‧凱許。

sentences.text: Their stories are unique, but all of them are inspiring.
sentences.zh: 他們的故事各不相同，但每一個都很激勵人心。

sentences.text: And after all, it's the Academy of Achievement's mission to show you don't need to be a superhero to make a difference.
sentences.zh: 畢竟，成就學會的使命就是要告訴大家，你不必是超級英雄，也能帶來改變。

sentences.text: Listen to the wisdom in these interviews, and you'll learn what it takes.
sentences.zh: 聽聽這些訪談裡的智慧，你就會知道成功需要具備什麼。
